title: Sodium smart-account ERC-1271 signer bypass (Arbitrum) — unpatched, $0, zero-capital re-arm
closed_reasons: every one of the 8,302 accounts pointing at the vulnerable impl is empty to dust
native ETH across all 8,302 accounts = 0.00247846 ETH (max single 0.00010636 ETH)
EntryPoint v0.6 deposits across 2,561 accounts = 0.00152372 ETH (max single 0.00001081 ETH)
ERC-20 dust across 1,021 accounts: USDT0 3.829086 + USDC 0.071867 + USDC.e 0.304477 (12-token basket)
gross residual dust ~$13.79 spread over 8,302 accounts; per-account value is at or below one handleOps gas cost, so net extractable is $0
no new accounts created by the factory since 2026-01-25 (account set static)
the second Sodium impl 0x46516e84... (207 accounts) does not reproduce the bypass (patched)
key_facts: live impl codehash matches Sourcify exact_match source (compiler 0.8.17) — the deployed code IS the vulnerable source

checkValidSodiumSignature(hash, 0x01||attacker||0x00) returns valid=true, signer=attacker on the live proxy 0x0209d8fc... (eth_call + state override, block 517458210); an EOA signer returns valid=false
validateUserOp -> _approvePaymasterToken unconditionally approves an attacker paymaster for type(uint256).max when validationData=0; the allowance survives the failed (callGasLimit=0) execution
gas-prefund drain: no-paymaster handleOps with inflated maxFeePerGas and beneficiary=attacker pays the attacker from the victim's prefund; fork PoC: 10-ETH victim pays attacker 0.269068 ETH in one op
historical: 11.761122 ETH / ~300 wallets (2026-07-12, anomly.rs) + ~$270k tokens (2026-07-13, Verichains/DeFiHackLabs)
re-arm: any ETH/ERC-20 arriving at any of the 8,302 accounts is drainable by anyone with zero capital
caveats: token census uses a 12-token basket; the primitive works for any ERC-20
account list derived from the factory's CREATE2 internal-tx history (Etherscan V2); a node-level scan could in principle find a differently-created account
net-of-gas assumes ~$0.01-0.05 per handleOps on Arbitrum; even the single largest account ($0.25) nets only ~$0.20
monitor: analysis/monitor.py — checks all 8,302 accounts for native ETH / EntryPoint deposits above dust and exits non-zero on re-arm
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0.00 net live (gross dust $13.79 over 8,302 accounts, at/below gas cost); the ERC-1271 signer bypass + validation-phase token approval are unpatched and live, so any future funding of any Sodium proxy is drainable by anyone with zero capital — a HIGH-severity E-U-conditional re-arm.
